name: switch-remote
description: Lets Claude press buttons, take screenshots, move files and launch builds on your modded Switch over your network, for testing homebrew games.
long_description: Made for testing homebrew games on a real console: Claude can drive the game with button presses, look at the screen, swap test files and pull logs back, without you copying files by hand. It talks to three things on a Switch running Atmosphere: the sys-botbase sysmodule (controller input, screenshots), the ftpsrv sysmodule (SD card files) and the homebrew menu netloader (sending and launching .nro builds and collecting their printf output). Changes on the SD card are limited to /switch.

tools.name: switch_status
tools.description: Check the connection to the Switch

tools.name: switch_press
tools.description: Send a sequence of button, stick and touch inputs

tools.name: switch_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the Switch screen

tools.name: switch_list_files
tools.description: List a folder on the SD card

tools.name: switch_read_file
tools.description: Read a file from the SD card

tools.name: switch_write_file
tools.description: Write a file to the SD card

tools.name: switch_move
tools.description: Rename or move a file or folder inside /switch

tools.name: switch_download_folder
tools.description: Copy a whole SD card folder to the PC

tools.name: switch_wait_for_file
tools.description: Wait until a file on the SD card exists or contains some text

tools.name: switch_run_build
tools.description: Run a .sh build script through WSL (opt-in)

tools.name: switch_launch_nro
tools.description: Send and launch a .nro through the homebrew menu netloader

tools.name: switch_read_output
tools.description: Read output printed by the launched homebrew

switch_ip.title: Switch IP address
switch_ip.description: Your Switch's IP address, from System Settings > Internet > Connection Status. Reserve it on your router so it doesn't change.

ftp_user.title: FTP user
ftp_user.description: Must match user in /config/ftpsrv/config.ini on the SD card.

ftp_pass.title: FTP password
ftp_pass.description: Must match pass in /config/ftpsrv/config.ini on the SD card (build-sysmodules.sh prints it).

work_dir.title: Work folder
work_dir.description: Builds are sent from here and downloads, screenshots and logs are saved here. Nothing outside it is read or written.

allow_builds.title: Allow build scripts
allow_builds.description: Lets Claude run .sh build scripts from the work folder through WSL, so it can rebuild before a test round. Off by default.

wsl_distro.title: WSL distro for builds
wsl_distro.description: The WSL distro the build scripts run in (see wsl -l).
